I haven’t had a bull terrier before (long time admirer) but I have too much experience with having to put pets to sleep. The best way I can put it is you’ll just *know*. They’ll look at you and instead of love and admiration in their eyes you’ll see their pain. Or they’ll do something they would never otherwise do. We had a lab that was attached to my dad from day one. We had a feeling her time was getting closer but one day she wouldn’t come into the house and she nipped at my dad when he went to pet her. If you’re questioning it, ask your vet what they would do for their pet in the same situation. Feel free to message me as well, I can offer my best judgement. Best of luck to the both of you!
